issues.display_title: Issue #1814: Extend "My Tours" List API Endpoint to Support Multi-attribute Sorting
issues.main_description_html:
List Tours sort_by Implementation

GET /v1/tours/list

Auth: middleware('auth')

Flow

  1. ListToursController@handle reads query parameters and builds ListToursDto.
  2. ListToursAction::execute maps sort_by to a whitelisted database column and direction.
  3. ToursRepository::getModerationsPage applies filters, sorting, and pagination.
  4. The controller returns an encrypted response by default, or plain JSON when the enc header is false.

Sorting

sort_by value Column Direction
size disk_usage Largest first
date_created date_created Newest first
date_modified date_updated Newest first
alphabetically business_name A-Z
omitted or unsupported date_updated Newest first

Sorting is applied before limit and page. size uses only disk_usage; it does not include disk_usage_cube. The disk_usage value controls ordering but is not added to the response payload.

DTO

app/DTOs/Tours/ListToursDto.php

Field Type Source Notes
userId int auth middleware Authenticated user ID
limit int limit query Optional; default 5, minimum 1
page int page query Optional; default 1, minimum 1
offset int computed (page - 1) * limit
tag string tag query Optional tag filter
type string type query Optional tour-type filter
search string search query Optional keyword filter
sortBy string sort_by query Optional; unsupported values use default sorting
encrypt bool enc header Optional; default true

Plain Response (200)

Send enc: false to receive readable JSON.

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "messages": "Data retrieved successfully.",
    "list_tours": [
      {
        "business_name": "Example Tour",
        "moderation_id": 123,
        "date_created": "2026-08-01 10:00:00",
        "last_save": "2026-08-31 12:00:00",
        "total_panorama": 10
      }
    ],
    "pagination": {
      "total_data": 1,
      "total_page": 1,
      "limit": 5,
      "page": 1
    }
  }
}

Encrypted Response (200)

Without enc: false, the payload is encrypted.

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "messages": "Data retrieved successfully.",
    "cry": "<encrypted payload>",
    "ls": "...",
    "e4": "..."
  }
}

Errors

domainCode HTTP Condition
TOURS.TYPE_NOT_FOUND 409 An unsupported type filter is supplied
fallback Throwable dynamic An unexpected failure occurs

Missing or unsupported sort_by values do not produce an error.

Usage

# Default: most recently modified first
curl "https://api.gothru.co/v1/tours/list?page=1&limit=10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {token}" \
  -H "enc: false"

# Largest disk_usage first
curl "https://api.gothru.co/v1/tours/list?page=1&limit=10&sort_by=size" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {token}" \
  -H "enc: false"

# Newest creation date first
curl "https://api.gothru.co/v1/tours/list?page=1&limit=10&sort_by=date_created" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {token}" \
  -H "enc: false"

# Most recently modified first
curl "https://api.gothru.co/v1/tours/list?page=1&limit=10&sort_by=date_modified" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {token}" \
  -H "enc: false"

# Business name A-Z
curl "https://api.gothru.co/v1/tours/list?page=1&limit=10&sort_by=alphabetically" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {token}" \
  -H "enc: false"

Description:

Update the tours retrieval API endpoint to parse and execute database query sorting based on asset size, timestamps, and title fields.

Acceptance Criteria:

  1. Update the GET /tours endpoint to accept sort_by (size, created_at, updated_at, title) and sort_order (asc, desc) query parameters.
  2. Ensure database indexes exist on created_at, updated_at, title, and storage size attributes to prevent performance bottlenecks on large tour lists.
  3. Return properly ordered paginated results matching the requested sort criteria.

issues.display_title: Issue #1812: Implement DB transaction + idempotency guard for Stripe one-time payments
issues.main_description_html:
Context

Research found that all Stripe one-time payment flows charge first, then write to DB with no transaction. Mid-flow failure = user charged but feature not unlocked, no refund. Retry = double charge + duplicate records.

Scope (7 flows)

  • BuyToken
  • UnlockPublish
  • UnlockPublishBlueLine
  • UnlockStitching
  • UnlockModeration
  • UnlockOverlay
  • UnlockOverlayPublic (uses UnlockOverlayHelpers)

Tasks

  1. Wrap post-charge DB writes in multi-connection transaction (ccdb + moderation/hosted_tours/tokens), per-connection pattern from PreviewRepository::transaction().
  2. Move invoice PDF + Plunk email + elastic AFTER commit (invoice reads cc_purchase).
  3. Fix UnlockModeration ordering: unlock gothru_moderation before success email.
  4. Pre-charge idempotency guard (per-flow business key) + updateOrInsert on transid in CCLogClass::addEntry() / CCTransClass::insert() (generalize AddEntryStripe pattern).
  5. Post-charge catch must call process*Failure (cc_logs + email) + throw, not just 409.

Files

  • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Actions/Stripe/OneTimePayment/*.php (7)
  • app/Http/Controllers/Payment/Helpers/OneTimePayment/*Helpers.php (7)
  • app/Class/CCLogClass.php
  • app/Class/CCTransClass.php
